info.title: Linha
info.description: Versioned JSON base protocol. SDKs wrap these operations. Result templates and policies are snapshotted; job IDs survive process restarts. Authentication follows deployment configuration: security.enabled=false disables client and worker authentication; security.oidc.enabled=false disables only client authentication. Anonymous clients share owner anonymous. Secured deployments require the bearer schemes below.

post.summary: Persist an immutable owned backend specification; readiness is separate
Return an ID after durable acceptance, before engine execution

parameters.name: path
parameters.description: Path from the published part index. Authorization and expiry checked on every request.

destinationFingerprint.description: Server-computed physical destination identity; credentials are excluded.

settings.description: Engine-specific configuration. Spark 3.5.6 uses the SparkSettings schema, including kubernetes.driverPodTemplate and executorPodTemplate. Other adapters define their own settings.

clientId.description: Unique process identity; generated if omitted. Renew the returned lease.

EnsureRequest.description: Ensures an immutable version under a stable owner/name, hashing normalized effective configuration and the resolved worker image. Changed settings create another version. Acquires or renews a client lease.

Context.description: Immutable backend version. GET does not renew a client lease. DRAINING finishes accepted work; STOPPED retains job history and results. Ensure and attach return clientLease.

exceptionType.description: Observed exception class/type; maximum 1024 UTF-8 bytes.

stackTrace.description: Plain text traceback including causes and suppressed exceptions, when available. Maximum 65536 UTF-8 bytes.

stackTraceTruncated.description: True if the worker shortened the trace. Optional on legacy failures.

Failure.description: Durable job or attempt failure. Diagnostic fields are optional for legacy workers or process loss; reporting remains fenced by the current attempt. Observed JVM OutOfMemoryError causes use OUT_OF_MEMORY.

PodTemplate.description: Native Kubernetes metadata/spec fragment, max 64 KiB. Runtime container name: main. Linha/Spark managed lifecycle fields are rejected. Maps merge recursively; containers/initContainers merge by name; env/volumes/imagePullSecrets replace by name; volumeMounts replace by mountPath; other arrays replace. Null/delete directives are unsupported. See docs/pod-templates.md.

spec.description: Kubernetes v1 PodSpec fields subject to managed-field validation.

SparkSettings.description: Spark 3.5.6 through Kubeflow Spark Operator v2.4.0. Memory is JVM heap; memoryOverhead is additional container memory. Deprecated memoryMi is an alternative heap alias.

coreLimit.description: CPU limit; defaults to cores; must be >= request.

javaOptions.description: Extra JVM options; heap overrides are rejected.

coreLimit.description: CPU limit; defaults to cores; must be >= request.

javaOptions.description: Extra JVM options; heap overrides are rejected.

executorIdleTimeout.description: Idle executors without retained data. Applies only with dynamicAllocation=true. Use integer s/m/h/d durations, at most 2147483647 seconds; empty means omitted. Finite cache/shuffle retention may require recomputation. Equivalent durations normalize to seconds.

cachedExecutorIdleTimeout.description: Idle executors holding cached blocks. Applies only with dynamicAllocation=true. Use integer s/m/h/d durations, at most 2147483647 seconds; empty means omitted. Finite cache/shuffle retention may require recomputation. Equivalent durations normalize to seconds.

shuffleTrackingTimeout.description: Executors retained by shuffle tracking. Applies only with dynamicAllocation=true. Use integer s/m/h/d durations, at most 2147483647 seconds; empty means omitted. Finite cache/shuffle retention may require recomputation. Equivalent durations normalize to seconds.

ui.description: Driver UI; disabled by default. Access by port-forwarding the driver. Does not create a public Ingress.

path.description: Validated relative part path; never an arbitrary storage key.

hadoopOptions.description: Ephemeral per-write settings including prefix-scoped STS credentials. Do not log or persist.

clientBearer.description: Validated OIDC token; explicitly configured development token only in development mode

workerBearer.description: Credential scoped to worker context and incarnation
